However, neither passage provides evidence that a 600°C anneal reduces or homogenizes this segregation, nor that doing so improves toughness; these intervention and outcome premises are unsupported by the cited evidence.
premises: Nanoclustering of Cr, Ni, and Mn at grain boundaries reduces GB cohesion in CrMnFeCoNi.
This GB segregation causes ductility loss and intergranular cracking.
Annealing at 600°C can reduce or homogenize this nanoclustering.
Reducing GB segregation will preserve GB cohesion and improve toughness.
